name: opendialer
description: Self-hosted call-center auto-dialer: campaigns, lead lists, DNC, preview/progressive dialing, WebRTC softphone, reports. Windows, macOS, Linux, Android (PWA).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @opendialer/shared && npm run build -w @opendialer/web && npm run build -w @opendialer/server
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @opendialer/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @opendialer/server" "npm run dev -w @opendialer/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @opendialer/shared && npm run test -w @opendialer/server && npm run test -w @opendialer/web
